tags.description: A charcoal-grey pouch with a cartoon flame wearing sunglasses. SMOKED EMBER — FLAME-KISSED FLAVOUR! Nothing about it has been near a flame; the smoke is a powder and it's listed fourth.
tags.use_message: Smoke, but not woodsmoke. The specific ashy note of a building that has burned with its contents still inside. Whoever formulated this has smelled that and thought: people will pay for this. They were right, and it isn't even bad.
